Name: Haneda Airport (HND)
Notes: Land Oct 27 at 2:35 PM (Delta 121). Leave Nov 11 at 5:15 PM (Delta 120). Toei Asakusa Line runs through to Haneda from Asakusabashi

Name: Asakusabashi Station
Notes: Next to the first hotel. JR Chuo-Sobu local and Toei Asakusa Line (direct to HND and Oshiage)

Name: Bakurocho Station
Notes: 5-7 min walk from the first hotel. JR Yokosuka Line straight to Kita-Kamakura on Oct 29

Name: Ryogoku Station
Notes: Next to the second hotel. JR Sobu Line, 2 stops to Akihabara and 1 to Asakusabashi

Name: Akihabara Station (Tsukuba Express)
Notes: Nov 9 about 7:50 AM. TX Rapid to Tsukuba, pay with IC card. Also TX from Asakusa to here on Oct 28 about 2:15 PM

Name: Tokyo Station
Notes: Oct 31 Nozomi 141 to Nagoya departs 9:45 AM (booked). Sit on the right side (D/E seats) for Mt. Fuji. Arrive from Kanazawa Nov 7 at 4:20 PM on Kagayaki 534 (not booked yet)

Name: Kuramae Station
Notes: Other way to HND on Nov 11. About 13 min walk from the Ryogoku hotel, Asakusa Line with no JR leg. Route not confirmed yet

Name: Kita-Kamakura Station
Notes: Oct 29. Get off here, one stop before Kamakura. About 1 hr from Bakurocho on the Yokosuka Line

Name: Kamakura Station
Notes: Oct 29. Enoden to Enoshima from here. Leave by 3 PM. Sit on the ocean side

Name: Shonan-Enoshima Station
Notes: Oct 29 return. Shonan Monorail to Ofuna, then Yokosuka Line back to Bakurocho

Name: Tsukuba Station
Notes: Nov 9. TX Rapid from Akihabara about 45 min. Shuttle bus leaves from stop 1 at Tsukuba Center. Last toilet and konbini stop

Name: Tsukubasan-jinja-iriguchi bus stop
Location: Tsukubasan Jinja Iriguchi, Tsukuba, Ibaraki, Japan
Notes: Nov 9. Shuttle bus stop for the shrine, about 38 min from Tsukuba Center. Last weekday bus back is 5:15 PM. Check the pin location

Name: Nagoya Station
Location: Nagoya Station, Nakamura Ward, Nagoya, Aichi, Japan
Notes: Arrive Oct 31 at 11:23 AM on Nozomi 141 from Tokyo. Hida 5 to Takayama leaves Nov 2 at 9:39 AM (booked). Print the ticket at a machine and be on the platform by 9:25. Sit on the right side (A seats) for the gorge

Name: Hisaya-odori Station
Location: Hisaya-odori Station, Naka Ward, Nagoya, Aichi, Japan
Notes: The hotel's station, about 4 min walk. Sakuradori Line 3 stops to Nagoya Station. Meijo Line 2 stops to Yaba-cho (Oct 31), 1 stop to Nagoyajo and 7 stops to Atsuta Jingu Nishi (Nov 1). Mirai Tower is right here

Name: Kintetsu Nagoya Station
Location: Kintetsu Nagoya Station, Nakamura Ward, Nagoya, Aichi, Japan
Notes: Nov 1 about 4:30 PM. Buy the Nabana no Sato illumination set ticket (3670 yen: round-trip Kintetsu and bus, admission and the 1000 yen voucher) at the limited-express ticket window. Kintetsu has its own station under Nagoya Station next to Meitetsu, not on the JR side

Name: Kintetsu Nagashima Station
Location: Kintetsu Nagashima Station, Kuwana, Mie, Japan
Notes: Nov 1 about 4:45 PM on the way to Nabana no Sato. About 22 min from Kintetsu Nagoya (weekend expresses stop here from Oct 31), then the direct bus about 10 min. Last bus back from Nabana is about 10 PM on Sundays

Name: JR Takayama Station
Notes: Arrive Nov 2 about 12:15 PM on Hida 5 from Nagoya (booked). Buy the Nov 4 Hida 3 reserved seat here on arrival. Hida 3 leaves Nov 4 at 11:03 AM for Toyama. Coin lockers here

Name: Takayama Nohi Bus Center
Location: Takayama Nohi Bus Center, Takayama, Gifu, Japan
Notes: Kamikochi buses Nov 3. Across from JR Takayama Station. Buy the Takayama to Kamikochi round-trip ticket at the counter. Line up by 6:40 for the 7 AM bus. No reservations and it is a holiday

Name: Hirayu Onsen Bus Terminal
Location: Hirayu Onsen Bus Terminal, Takayama, Gifu, Japan
Notes: Transfer point Nov 3 between the Takayama bus and the Kamikochi shuttle. About 1 hr from Takayama. Shuttle runs through Nov 15

Name: Kamikochi Bus Terminal
Location: Kamikochi Bus Terminal, Kamikochi, Matsumoto, Nagano, Japan
Notes: Arrive Nov 3 about 8:30 AM. First get a free numbered return ticket at the Kamikochi Sightseeing Center window here. Plan is the 4 PM bus back. Last connection to Takayama is 5 PM

Name: Toyama Station
Notes: Nov 4 transfer. Hida 3 arrives 12:32 PM. Tsurugi 23 Shinkansen at 12:41 to Kanazawa (1:03). Backups: Hakutaka 559 at 1:14 or the Ainokaze/IR local at 1:20 (Kanazawa 2:19)

Name: Kanazawa Station
Notes: Arrive Nov 4 at 1:03 PM from Toyama. IR Ishikawa local to Kaga Onsen at 7:32 AM Nov 5. Kagayaki 534 to Tokyo Nov 7 at 1:50 PM (not booked yet). Loop Bus and Kenrokuen Shuttle leave from the east exit

Name: Kaga Onsen Station
Location: Kaga Onsen Station, Kaga, Ishikawa, Japan
Notes: Nov 5. About 46 min on the IR Ishikawa local from Kanazawa. Hokutetsu bus to Yamanaka from stop 2 at 8:35 AM (no IC cards: cash or contactless credit card). CAN Bus is 500 yen per ride paid on board, so skip the day pass. Tsurugi 26 back to Kanazawa at 3:20 PM
